```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Write Table Header
cat('<table style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">')
cat('<tr style="background-color: #f2f2f2;"><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr>')

# 3. The Loop
for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  # Build Image URL (JSDelivr is safest)
  img_url <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i]), "@main/Capture.PNG")
  
  # Build Demo URL - FIXED TO AVOID 404
  # This takes 'aakritixyz/repo-name' and makes it '[https://aakritixyz.github.io/repo-name/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/repo-name/)'
  repo_path <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  demo_url <- paste0("https://", gsub("/.*", "", repo_path), ".github.io/", gsub(".*/", "", repo_path), "/")
  
  cat('<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;">')
  # We use raw <img> tag. If it still shows brackets, we will know Pandoc is the enemy.
  cat(paste(
    '<td><img src="', img_url, '" width="250"></td>',
    '<td><strong style="font-size: 18px;">', dt$title[i], '</strong></td>',
    '<td><a href="', demo_url, '" style="font-weight:bold;">Interactive Demo</a><br><br>',
    '<a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source Code</a></td>'
  ))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</table>')
